test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

Emily’s stoic silence conveyed a grim picture __in her growing strife within the family__.

options.text: across the growing strife within her family
without her growing strife within the family
of the growing strife within her family

solution:
The correct answer is "**of the growing strife within her family.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of the preposition "in" is incorrect. 
 
• **"Of" is a preposition that shows possession or relationship between two things.**
 
• In this sentence, "of the growing strife within her family" shows what the grim picture is related to.
 
• This option maintains the original meaning and grammatical structure of the sentence.
 
• The correct sentence will be: 
 
 
• Emily’s stoic silence conveyed a grim picture of her growing strife within the family.__
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "across the growing strife within her family," does not accurately convey the meaning of the original sentence.
 
• Option 3, "without her growing strife within the family," changes the meaning of the sentence and does not make logical sense.
